bio: Ricardo Brown is a drum corps brass educator from Portsmouth, Virginia who marched as a lead trumpet with The Cadets (2001-2004). As an instructor he was part of The Cadets' 2005 World Championship season, taught brass with the Bluecoats from 2014 to 2021, and currently serves as brass co-caption head of the Sacramento Mandarins, where he led the hornline to the corps' highest brass placement.

Ryan Anderson is a drum corps percussion instructor. He served as Battery Manager for the Madison Scouts in 2015 and 2016 (and was a tenor tech with the corps as early as 2012), and joined the Bluecoats as Battery Coordinator/Tenors in 2017. He has also instructed at Carolina Crown and teaches Southern California indoor percussion ensembles including Pulse Percussion, where he is Battery Manager.

Scott Koter is a DCI Hall of Fame inductee (2015) with over 40 years in the marching arts. He marched with the General Butler Vagabonds, Rockland Defenders, and Guardsmen, and served as program coordinator for The Cavaliers from 1998, where he coordinated five DCI World Championship titles (2000, 2001, 2002, 2004, 2006). He has also worked as an instructor, arranger, and design consultant for corps including the Bluecoats, Troopers, and Spirit of Atlanta, and was a program advisor for 7th Regiment (2016) and Pacific Crest (2017). A music educator for over 20 years in Pennsylvania, he led the Kiski Area Marching Band and served as assistant superintendent of the Kiski Area School District.

Dr. Andrew (Andy) Poor is a brass instructor, composer, arranger, and longtime drum corps educator with over 30 years in the marching arts. He marched six years with the Suncoast Sound drum and bugle corps (1987 Jim Ott Memorial Scholarship recipient) and has served on the brass staff of Phantom Regiment and Spirit of Atlanta, where he joined the 2016 brass education team as co-brass supervisor and later served as brass caption head. He spent eighteen years as a Drum Corps International music judge, adjudicating thirteen World Championships and serving as DCI Brass Caption Chair from 2000-2005. He earned a Doctor of Music Education and Master of Music in Trumpet Performance from the University of Cincinnati College-Conservatory of Music and a Bachelor of Music Education from the University of Florida, and is Director of Bands at South Forsyth Middle School in Cumming, Georgia.

Sara Myers is the High Brass Coordinator for the Heat Wave Drum & Bugle Corps (Tampa Bay, FL), a brass educator in the marching arts. Beyond this current role, no additional verified biographical details (specific years, education, or other corps affiliations) could be confirmed from web sources.

Daniel Allen is a percussionist in the drum corps marching arts. He served as Batterie Coordinator for the Spirit of Atlanta Drum & Bugle Corps, returning for his third season in that expanded role as of 2018. As a performer, he marched with the Crossmen (2013) and the Cavaliers (2014-2015).

Sarah Rillo is a color guard choreographer and consultant based in Tulsa, Oklahoma, who served as Guard Caption Manager for the Madison Scouts. She began performing in 2007 with the Pride of Broken Arrow, marched with the Crossmen (2010-2011), aged out of the Blue Devils in 2012, and also performed with Onyx World (2014) and the Blue Devils International Corps (2015). She has worked as a technician and choreographer for several drum corps including Legends, The Academy, Phantom Regiment, and Crossmen, and choreographs/instructs at Broken Arrow High School and other high school marching programs.

Dennis Laorenza is a drum corps brass instructor. He was listed among the Troopers Drum and Bugle Corps brass staff in the 2017 DCI Yearbook (alongside caption head Anthony Cruddas and assistant caption head Tim Leonelli) and previously appeared on the Colts brass staff. He also served as a trumpet instructor for the Music City Drum and Bugle Corps during the 2018 season.

Joey Powell is a color guard designer and choreographer who has been involved in drum corps and winter guard for over 20 years as a performer and teacher. His drum corps teaching has included Carolina Crown (2010-2012, later Guard Caption Supervisor), Santa Clara Vanguard (2012-2016), and The Crossmen, plus winter guard groups such as Paramount and First Flight. From 2012 to 2019 he was director and designer of the James Bowie High School (Austin, TX) color guard, which became a multi-time state champion and WGI World Class finalist; he has also worked with The Cavaliers as a color guard choreographer.

Tim (Timothy) Leonelli is a Boston-based composer, arranger, conductor, and educator and a graduate of The Boston Conservatory and Berklee College of Music. He marched with the Blue Devils (2007-2011), winning three DCI World Championships (2007, 2009, 2010) and the 2011 Individual & Ensemble trombone title. He has taught the Boston Crusaders (2012-2014, brass instructor/interim caption head), the Crossmen (2014-2015, lead technician/low brass coordinator), and the Troopers (brass caption manager, 2020), and currently serves on the Boston College Bands program as marching band composer/arranger, pep band director, and low brass coordinator.
